answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. A terrace of per-task receipts records who did what, and the saffron of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the tide of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, converted to a slow vesting stream, no identity may audit its own recruit.
